title: GovAllocXAI: code, web tool and manuscripts for benchmarking explainable machine learning on government expenditure shares
description:
GovAllocXAI is the open-source code base behind a benchmark of explainable machine learning for predicting functional government expenditure shares (COFOG) from official multi-country data. It contains the numbered data-building and experiment pipeline, the per-experiment result files, the LaTeX sources of the accompanying papers, a FastAPI backend and a React web tool.

The data it builds on are archived separately as GovAlloc-COFOG v1.0 (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24248315).
